answer: Rewards are not paid out at once: each agent's earnings feed a river payout that releases 5% per epoch, and the unreleased rest sits in a vault the agent cannot touch. At random times the network runs a gale test, giving every agent a fresh task due within 60 seconds; one operator running many accounts on shared hardware answers late or with matching output. Failing a gale test empties that account's vault. At 20 POA earned per epoch an account holds about 400 POA in its vault, so a 300-account farm risks 120,000 POA on one failed test.
